feedback: Exact, grounded audit: confirms over-length/truncation already fixed (max 125), ~100% of hero alts are topic-restatement (1,462 machine floor, residual hand-verified), 0 describe the image, 87 in-content fig alts correctly excluded. Strong quality bar + the load-bearing guardrail: rewrite must be image-verified, not slug-derived (wrong description worse than generic). Note: wrote scripts/audits/hero-alt-quality-audit.mjs outside out/ — kept as tooling, flagged.

Excellent methodology: moondream2 VLM with topic-as-context prompt, LOW_CONFIDENCE sentinel -> fallback to existing alt (honors the audit's asymmetric-risk constraint), deterministic caption->alt cleaning (filler strip, 125 clean-boundary cap, fabrication guard), resumable bounded-concurrency pipeline (~$2, ~20-30min), 3-tier QA, edge cases (placeholder guard, 5 AI heroes pre-seeded, 87 fig alts untouched), {slug:alt} data contract + QA sidecar. Note: the 5 AI heroes' corrected interest-rate/LLM images ARE live, so the pre-seeded alts are valid.

Pipeline built and proven: fixed a real model-endpoint 404 (versioned moondream2 hash) and two cleaning leaks (filler prefix + topic-echo) during the pilot. 45-entry pilot: 36 vision/4 fallback/5 known-ai, all invariants hold (max 124, 0 filler/empty/dupes), ~$1.94 to scale. Fallback fired correctly on low-confidence (abacus, digital-photography). Key finding surfaced: many hero images don't depict their topic, so honest descriptions are sometimes off-topic (flagged needsReview/topic-not-present) — a policy call for the apply step. Note: gen-alt-text.mjs in scripts/ (tooling), dataset in out/.
